package.name: semantic_voice
package.description: Voice control for the semantic navigation stack: Whisper (faster-whisper) transcription with push-to-talk / VAD / text activation, and a rules+regex intent parser that dispatches to NavigateToPose, CaptureWaypoint and NavigateToSemanticGoal. Speech/intent logic lives in a pure-Python core (semantic_voice.core) with no ROS dependency.
